note: **Hope Drive, schedules 100 and 101 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** A street of gun and aero workers six days after the register was taken.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A

1939 Register, schedule 110, 6 Hope Drive, ED letter code RMGB, Nottingham registration district 430-3, sub-district 26, The National Archives RG101/6178A - read from the page by A.
